description: Drex Max Finance is the finance version of Drex Max, Nace.AI's 27B multimodal decision model, for banking, accounting, payments, insurance, credit, compliance, filings and markets. Given a state (text, JSON, or images such as invoices, receipts and statements) and typed questions (yes/no, multiple choice, or ordinal score), it returns a calibrated probability for every option in a single forward pass, with no text generation. It is TypeSafe System One compatible, handles contexts up to 262K tokens, and scores 77.3 on Nace's Finance Index of 48 held-out finance test sets, 11.5 points above Drex Max v1.1.
